summary: Fiserv filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior notes due 20.. and 20.. . The offering is unsecured, book-entry, and subject to optional redemption and a change-of-control repurchase provision. Proceeds, combined with commercial paper and cash, will fund a tender offer for $750M 5.150% notes due 2027 and $2.0B 4.400% notes due 2049. No price terms, premium, or advisors are disclosed. This is a routine debt financing / refinancing, not a transformative special situation. Risk-arb angle: N/A.
